requirements.title: ES output uses scientific notation and ignores scale factor
requirements.definition: ES output uses scientific notation with significand magnitude in [1,10) except zero; scale factor has no output effect.
requirements.oracle:

S13.7.2.3.5-001 ES runtime fixtures: complete internal-file programs write exact default-real values using SS and explicit ES w.dE2 fields. 0.5 expects '   5.000E-01', exercising scientific notation; 0.125 expects '   1.250E-01', exercising the 1<=significand<10 interval; the scale-factor fixture writes 0.5 with (SS,2P,ES12.3E2) and with a 0P control and expects the same field because ES output ignores scale factor. Descriptor substitutions ES<->EN, ES<->E, w, d, and e mutations are permanent and fail.

requirements.title: Table 13.3 enumerates ES exponent forms
requirements.definition: Table 13.3 gives row-by-row ES exponent forms for ES w.d, ES w.d E e, ES w.d E0, and ES0.d, with z digits, s minimum digits, and plus sign for zero exponent.

pending.table13_3_ES_w_d_abs_le_99: Unassertable as one exact string for this row: Table 13.3 permits either E±z1z2 or ±0z1z2 for ES w.d with w>0 and |exp|<=99. Use ES w.d E e for byte-exact output.
pending.table13_3_ES_w_d_abs_100_to_999: Unassertable as a portable byte-exact plan in this packet: the row requires an exponent magnitude at least 100 and the table form omits the E letter.
pending.table13_3_ES_Ee_positive: Row checked visually: ES w.d E e with e>0 uses E±z1...ze; WRITE(buf,'(SS,ES12.3E2)') 8.0 expects '   8.000E+00'.
pending.table13_3_ES_E0_or_ES0_d: Row checked visually: ES w.d E0 or ES0.d uses E±z1...zs with minimum exponent digits. Internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,ES0.3E0)') 8.0 to character(len=8) expects exactly buf='8.000E+0'.
pending.table13_3_zero_exponent_plus: Row footnote checked visually: exponent zero has plus sign; the 8.0 ES12.3E2 plan expects '+00'.
